name: Find the Penguins 🐧
desc:
🐧 Welcome to Find The Penguins Search through the map and collect cute penguins!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden penguins
🏆 Find all penguins the fastest for a spot on the leaderboard

🤝 Find penguins with friends and meet new friends along the way!
🎒 Equip the penguins you collect!
📜 What's new? – A Cave biome has cracked open along the side of the map, with tunnels stretching underground! 16 new penguins are tucked away among ores, shadows, and secrets.

scripts.title: Find All Penguins
scripts.features:
Find all penguins at a rate of 1 penguin per 6 seconds because the game has a cooldown
⚠️RERUN IF ONE IS MISSED⚠️
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local collectiblesFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ToFind")
if not collectiblesFolder then
    warn("No 'Collectibles' folder found in Workspace.")
    return
end

local touchPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")

if not touchPart then
    warn("Could not find a valid part in the character to use for touch simulation.")
    return
end

for _, descendant in ipairs(collectiblesFolder:GetDescendants()) do
    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter") then
        -- Fire the touch using the player’s actual body part
        firetouchinterest(touchPart, descendant, 0) -- touch
        task.wait(6)
        firetouchinterest(touchPart, descendant, 1) -- untouch
    end
end
